description: Reads what the Stress Profile Generator can show for chosen beam elements: each element's section (type, outline verified, composite parts, tapered), material, length, the load cases / combinations / envelopes CIVIL NX publishes results for (with kind and whether each is one concurrent state), the construction stages with results for that element (and, with stage, that stage's results such as Summation). Also lists the model's combinations with the SLS category the plugin would guess. Read-only; reads results with a few batched /post/TABLE requests. Use it before stress_profile or sls_stress_check.

elements.description: Element list as the plugin takes it, e.g. "1-20, 35, 40 to 44".

group.description: A structure group; its beam elements are used.

stage.description: A construction stage: also list its results for each element.

name: stress_element_loads
title: Results available for beam elements (Stress Profile Generator)
